title: Origami Treasure
description:
Papelina wants to find the Origami Treasure, with the guidance of the treasure map, our adventurer travels to Folding Island.
She goes through different scenarios with unique obstacles and enemies, folds into various origami to adapt to the difficulties of the journey. 

Features
• With Papelita, explore Folding Island in this beautiful 2D platform.
• Fold into a paper plane, paper boat or paper frog to adapt to obstacles.
• 3 weather vanes in each level to collect.
• Travel across 4 worlds with a total of 32 stages.
• Defeat 4 bosses to find the Origami Treasure.
• Support for Xbox and DualShock controllers.
• Steam Achievements.

Can you to find the Origami Treasure?
description_short: Origami Treasure is a 2D platformer, where you are in the role of Papelina, an adventurer in search of the Origami Treasure. Face challenges, obstacles and enemies on this journey with its different folds.
